card.name: Inside foreign names and brand names
card.fires_on: Partway through a foreign personal name or place name, often a CJK character or German name piece, and in the middle of capitalized brand names like LUNSUMIO or LUTATHERA.

modes.label: East Asian name characters
modes.description: A Chinese or Japanese character inside a person's or place name, usually next to a romanized form.
modes.example: The major framework of Yogācāra theory was developed by the two brothers Vasubandhu 世<<親>> and Asaṅga 無

modes.label: German name pieces
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a German place or club name.
modes.example: Universum Cinema on Kurfür<<st>>endamm, the Columbushaus

modes.label: Capitalized drug brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps brand name in a drug label.
modes.example: Do not substitute LUN<<SUM>>IO for or with LUNSUMIO

card.writes: Little clear effect; it seems to push toward continuing a name with unusual name pieces rather than common words.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of foreign names and unusual brand names, before the name is finished.
